newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Pacific Islands lifts gold hedge book.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Islands lifts gold hedge book.

text.p: Pacific Islands Gold NL said on Tuesday it has sold an extra 20,000 ounces of gold forward at an average A$440 an ounce, taking its hedge book to about 62,000 ounces at an average A$479 an ounce.
Pacific Islands said 22,000 ounces were at A$535 for delivery over the next nine months, while 40,000 ounces had been sold for an average A$446 on a spot deferrred basis.
The lift in the hedge book was to ensure the company had viable gold prices in the event of a further, prolonged gold price fall. Pacific Islands operates the Mt Kasi mine in Fiji.
